question.text: A deferred annuity purchased during the working years provides:

answer.text: Income that begins at a specified future date, typically at retirement
A lump sum payment at maturity

explanation.text: The Logic: A deferred annuity builds the corpus during the deferment period (the working years) and annuity income starts at the vesting age or retirement, with the annuity bought at the rates applicable at that time. The Trap: Immediate income (Option A) describes an immediate annuity. A lump sum (Option C) describes an endowment-style payout, not an annuity income stream. Daily NAV-based returns (Option D) describe mutual funds, not annuities. Note: The deferment period is used to accumulate the corpus; the annuity income begins at vesting or retirement, with payout rates determined when the annuity is purchased.
